# Chaeboxi

> Local-first multi-platform AI copilot (Tauri 2 + React 18 + TypeScript). BYOK only, GPLv3. Desktop, web, and mobile targets.

## Documentation

- [Adding a New Provider (Registry Architecture)](adding-new-provider.md): This guide documents how to add a new AI provider to Chaeboxi using the **registry-based architecture**.
- [Adding a New Provider to Chaeboxi](adding-provider.md): This guide documents all the steps and files that need to be modified when adding a new AI provider to the Chaeboxi application.
- [Agents & multi-agent team rooms](agents-multi-agent-rooms.md): **Agents** (formerly Copilots) are persona packages: prompt, avatar, model overrides, tools, and hooks.
